title: Work item bindings
description: The source statement each register work item rests on: a phrase of one document that exactly one live entry contains. `rmf conformance bind` sets work_item on that entry; FW-REQ-004 fails when a phrase matches no entry or several, or the entry carries another work item.

phrase.description: A substring of the document text, matched after refs.toc.compact.

finding.description: The audit finding the phrase is the source of.
